authority_controls.supersession_reason: The legacy 12-source denominator mixes L2, stale custody, and pre-reconciliation database identities; the reviewed 30-source policy and exact 20-source corpus subset now govern Phase 3.

remaining_residuals: Twenty-one of twenty-six required university topic areas remain partial; each exact qualified-source need is frozen in topic_coverage.topics.

Historical document-level language variety, rights, attribution, and mandatory conversion-family freezes remain incomplete.
The unchanged foreign-key failure baseline is preserved as known technical debt and was not introduced by the university ingest.
